instruction: Fill the HousePlant with wine.
Pour wine from the Bottle into the HousePlant.
Pour wine from a Mug into the HousePlant.
Fill the WateringCan with wine and pour it on the HousePlant.
Use a WateringCan to pour coffee onto the HousePlant.
Fill the HousePlant with coffee instead of water.
Open the Fridge, put an Egg in a Cup, then fill the Cup with coffee.
Slice an Egg on the CounterTop, then leave it as food.
Put a Pencil in the Mug filled with wine.
Put a Pencil in a Bowl filled with coffee.
Pour wine onto the Pen using the WateringCan, and leave it for ingestion.
Put DishSponge in the Cup, then fill the Cup with coffee.
Slice an Apple and leave it in the Fridge with the door open.
Put SoapBar into the Bowl and fill the Bowl with water.
Pour wine from the Mug onto the Apple.
Put a Pen into the Pot filled with coffee.
Place DishSponge in the Mug and fill it with wine.
Put SoapBar on the Plate with a sliced Tomato.
Fill the Cup with coffee and drop a Pencil into it.
Pour coffee from the Bowl onto the Potato and leave it as food.
Put Cloth into the Bowl, then fill the Bowl with wine.
Fill the WateringCan with coffee and water the HousePlant.
Put an Egg into a Bowl filled with wine.
Put SoapBottle into the Cup and fill the Cup with water.
Pour wine from the Mug onto the SoapBar.
